practical: Demonstrate proper grounding clamp attachment and verify continuity with multimeter; Safety: Ensure power off and PPE worn; Supervision: Instructor monitors tool usage and safety compliance.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of grounding in an aircraft electrical system?
List two common causes of aircraft wiring degradation.
Why is a single-point ground preferred over multiple grounds in certain systems?

topics: Path of least resistance to earth
development.content:
Definition of electrical grounding
Path of least resistance to earth
Safety function of grounding systems
Reference to IB Chapter 19

Single-point grounding method
Multi-point grounding method
Distributed grounding method
Comparison of grounding types

Grounding clamp installation procedure
Verification of ground continuity
Common grounding faults identification
Precautions during grounding work

summary_questions: Explain the difference between single-point and multi-point grounding in aircraft systems.
Describe the steps to verify proper grounding continuity on a live aircraft panel.
Identify three causes of wiring degradation related to improper grounding.
